Name: L_Brow
Description: Will create a local Brows rig

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will create a local Brows rig.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- GameMode: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- Template parent examples: Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl, Spine_End_Jnt.
- Template attrs-position examples: L_Brow_Ctrl, Vis_Ctrl, L_Eyelids_Scale_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
